notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
When Metalwork Colossus enters, Grinding Station and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions token.
When the Munitions token enters, Grinding Station triggers. Resolve the Grinding Station triggers from this step and step 2, untapping it.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, Farid triggers, creating a Scrap token.
When the Scrap enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 5.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Scrap and Munitions tokens.
The Munitions token triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Metalwork Colossus ability, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
